title: Intravenous iron in the management of drug-resistant restless legs syndrome
official: Intravenous iron in the management of drug-resistant restless legs syndrome: a randomized controlled delayed-start trial. IRON-RLS
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of intravenous ferric carboxymaltose (FCM) 1000 mg administered according to AASM guidelines, compared with conventional management according to SFRMS recommendations, on the change in IRLSSG-Q score between the baseline visit (V1) and the 3-month follow-up visit (V3), in patients with pharmacoresistant restless legs syndrome (RLS).
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 18 years
2. Be affiliated with a health insurance system
3. Written informed consent for participation in the study
4. Body weight ≥ 50 kg
5. Pharmacoresistant restless legs syndrome (RLS)
6. Severe to very severe RLS (IRLSSG-Q score >20), persistent or recurrent for more than one month
7. Treatment with dopamine agonists without exceeding recommended doses (ropinirole ≤ 2 mg/day, pramipexole ≤ 0.54 mg/day, rotigotine ≤ 3 mg/day)
8. Stable treatment with dopamine agonists and/or α2δ ligands and/or opioids for at least 3 months
9. In the presence of sleep apnea syndrome, treatment with continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP)
10. Fluent in spoken and written French
11. Agree to the automated processing of anonymized confidential data
Exclusion criteria:
1. Iron supplementation (oral or intravenous) within the 6 months prior to inclusion and throughout the study period
2. Severe obstructive sleep apnea (apnea–hypopnea index >30/h) that is untreated, or in cases of refusal or failure of treatment
3. Known allergy, inflammatory or immune disorder
4. History of severe asthma, eczema, or any other atopic disease
5. Pregnancy or breastfeeding
6. Ongoing participation in a clinical study
7. Deprived of liberty by judicial or administrative decision
8. Living in a medicalized institution
9. Under legal protection
10. Failure to obtain consent
11. Serum ferritin <50 µg/L or >300 µg/L
12. Transferrin saturation coefficient <20% or >45%
13. Hemochromatosis
14. Augmentation syndrome in RLS
15. Treatment with antipsychotics or antidepressants
16. Known iron allergy
17. Severe infectious or inflammatory disease within the previous 3 months
18. RLS associated with chronic kidney disease, pregnancy, or a clinically significant neurological or psychiatric disorder
